summary: Reviewed QueueEntry interface (gui/orchestrator-manager.ts lines 72–95): lastAction and logFilename fields are cleanly defined with precise JSDoc including @remarks guidance on deriving hasStageActivity. No issues.

Reviewed getQueue() (lines 217–252): direct field mapping from progressResult with correct Promise.all parallelisation of I/O operations per entry. Spread pattern (...entry + three new fields) is clean and type-safe.

Reviewed resolveProgress (src/gui/queue/resolve-progress.ts): read-only, EMPTY_RESOLUTION sentinel reuse is correct (callers only read it), walk-backwards pattern correctly handles heartbeat-only files (logFilename set, lastAction/summary null), malformed-JSON catch is present.

Reviewed front-end (orchestrator.js + orchestrator-widgets.js): logFilename/expectedSlug both URL-encoded before href construction (good); lastAction properly escapeHtml'd in badge (good); || null coercion on lastAction is harmless defensive JS. All AC-3/AC-4/AC-5 rendering paths verified.

Reviewed 7 new AC-6 test cases: well-isolated, use real temp dirs, cover null paths, correct last-summarizable-action resolution, heartbeat-only edge case, and both-non-null correlation. Test names are clear and follow existing conventions.
No blocking issues. No Fix-Forward changes applied. One Documentation-Forward item recorded.

comments.note: resolveProgress returns the EMPTY_RESOLUTION sentinel object directly (not a spread copy). Current callers are read-only so there is no mutation risk, but the pattern is fragile for future consumers. Consider Object.freeze(EMPTY_RESOLUTION) at declaration to make the intent explicit and guard against accidental mutation — a one-line change with zero runtime cost.

[documentation-forward] QueueEntry.lastAction and QueueEntry.logFilename are newly exported fields on an exported interface in gui/orchestrator-manager.ts. The mcp-server api-surface.md manifest should document these two fields (type, nullability, semantics) so future agents and contributors can discover them without reading source.

PROGRESS_BADGE_MAP in orchestrator-widgets.js includes a 'heartbeat' entry, but resolveProgress never surfaces 'heartbeat' as lastAction (heartbeats are non-summarisable and skipped). The map entry is dead code but benign. A comment noting this exclusion would prevent future confusion.
